classification: RWA v1 verifier helper extraction with equivalent gates; no signed protocol or partner activation change
receiptImpact: No signed report schema, EIP-712 field order, digest, signature, registry release, key, partner policy or activation is changed. sdk/src/rwa.ts reuses shared internal v1 verification helpers while retaining strict verification and inspection error gates. The RWA source lock now pins the refactored source. Frozen v1 and v2 digest and signature vectors remain byte-exact; additional regression cases cover distinct v1 error gates.
activationRule: Existing partner policies and the current activation set remain unchanged. This promotion records implementation-equivalent SDK source changes only; it does not activate RWA for any partner, authorize a live run, claim partner acceptance or publish a new npm package. Production deployment remains subject to CI.
